notes: This sample preserves upstream identity for Epic 32 adaptation work.
The compose shape is derived from the official ClickHouse Docker install docs; the Websoft9 docker-library entry is used as a secondary reference only.
ClickHouse is a single-service application: the server both serves the HTTP interface (8123) and stores data. No separate database service is modeled.
The first pass stores source metadata rather than a full upstream file mirror.
